title: SoPhyFit: Soil physics fitting tool for retention, pore-size distribution and conductivity
description:
SoPhyFit fits soil water retention curves with six models (van Genuchten, Brooks-Corey, Kosugi, bimodal van Genuchten, and the PDI variants for the dry range), reports all parameters and derived quantities with 95% confidence intervals, and predicts the pore-size distribution, pore-class volumes and the unsaturated hydraulic conductivity from the fitted curve.

This record contains the Windows installer (SoPhyFit_Setup_<version>.exe), the user guide and the documentation. Releases: https://github.com/Tum-Soil-Biophysics/SoPhyFit/releases
